en: Colorized historic view of a river or moat with a rowboat in the foreground, grassy banks and trees on both sides, and a fortified hillside with stone walls and buildings to the right. In the distance rise several medieval towers and a prominent tall church spire of an old European city skyline. Printed captions identify the scene as Toompea's moat and the city of Tallinn (historically Reval).
